statement: Reasonix separates permission and approval posture from OS-level shell confinement: approval modes preserve explicit deny and fresh-decision rules, while an enforced but unavailable shell sandbox fails closed instead of running unwrapped.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix 将 permission/approval posture 与 OS-level shell confinement 分离：approval mode 保留显式 deny 与 fresh-decision 规则；当要求 enforce 但 sandbox 不可用时，shell 会 fail closed 而不是无隔离运行。
display_text.en: Reasonix separates permission and approval posture from OS-level shell confinement: approval modes preserve explicit deny and fresh-decision rules, while an enforced but unavailable shell sandbox fails closed instead of running unwrapped.

evidence.title: Reasonix approval manager and headless gates

notes: Platform enforcement was not executed. The source states that Windows has no OS-level Bash sandbox in this revision.
